images.screen: A · 순서를 읽다 — 사제와의 전투, 적의 다음 다섯 수가 타로 카드처럼 한 줄로 펼쳐져 있고 손패의 '역순'으로 앞의 두 수를 뒤바꾸려는 순간
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Roguelike deckbuilder card battle seen straight-on over a fortune-teller's table covered in deep oxblood velvet with soft folds, lit by three beeswax candles in the lower right that double as the energy meter. Top center: a tall engraved tarot card of the enemy, 'The Hierophant' in black-line woodcut hatching on cream parchment with one vermilion robe, gold-leaf frame; beside it the name '사제' and a thin red health bar. Middle band: the core mechanic made visible — five small face-up tarot intent cards strung on a glowing gold thread, numbered I to V, each showing an engraved sword, broken wand or chalice with a big number (14, 2, 9, 5, 16), the first card haloed as 'next', a sixth card face-down with a question mark. A dashed amber arc shows cards I and II about to swap. Bottom: fanned hand of five parchment cards with gold cost coins, the card '역순' raised. Warm candle glow, film grain, dark vignette, serif Korean typography. Korean HUD: '운명의 다섯 수', '다음', '기력'.

images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Climax of a roguelike deckbuilder boss fight over a dark oxblood velvet fortune-teller's table, colder and darker than before, faint lightning flashes washing the top of the screen. Top center: the boss tarot card 'The Tower' — engraved tower on a black crag struck by a white bolt, crown blown off, orange fire in the windows, tiny falling figures, gold frame on midnight ground; a nearly empty red health bar. A pulsing red warning line across the middle. Below it the row of five face-up tarot intent cards on a gold thread; the first card, a sword marked 24, is being covered by a black silk veil sliding down over it with a slanted vermilion ink stamp reading '지움'. Player health 9 of 50 glows red at left, crimson heartbeat vignette at the edges, three candle flames at right. Fanned parchment hand below with the rare card '가림막' lifted. Serif Korean typography, film grain. Korean HUD: '탑', '지움', '체력 9'.
